replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: Math is always been a challenge for me. I prefer understanding concepts through physics or philosophy rather than abstract formulas. I find numbers cold and disconnected from real life. I do my best with practical calculations, but advanced math makes my head spin. I have always felt more comfortable with words and ideas than with equations.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, sometimes. When I see complex equations or symbols, I feel overwhelmed and want to run away. It triggers that old feeling of not being good enough. My anxiety is higher when I think about my children trying to understand difficult subjects. I prefer to avoid it and focus on hobbies like cooking or football instead.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I never used AI for math, but I have heard about it. I do not trust technology to replace human understanding. I prefer talking to a teacher or a friend. I am skeptical about machines solving problems without grasping the logic. I have limited use of smartphones, and I am not tech-savvy enough for such tools.
replies.How would you explain, step by step, how: I would say it is hard. First, look at the equation with x squared. Then, identify the coefficients a, b, and c. Use the formula with square roots. But honestly, I do not remember the exact steps. I have to guess. I am not confident in this area and I cannot teach it properly.
